name: Run Tests Safe
description: Run a test suite under a hard 60s timeout, detect hangs, clear stale locks, and name the hanging file.

inputs.command: string, test command to run, for example npm test
inputs.repoPath: string, absolute path to the repo

outputs.summary: pass | fail | hung, real test output, hanging file when hung

tooltip: Run a test suite under a hard 60s timeout, detect hangs, clear stale locks, and name the hanging file.
